content.short: Brú Finance is building a decentralized P2P impact bonds platform backed by tokenized assets.
content.description: Brú Finance enables a decentralized peer-to-peer impact bonds platform backed by tokenized assets. The project connects lenders in developed markets with emerging-market debt, secured by tokenized assets such as commodities, equities, gold, inventory, and receivables. This broader financial system is built on sound economics rather than speculative trading, aiming to channel yield-seeking capital toward real-world assets in emerging economies through a transparent, blockchain-based bond market.
